# Client intake templates

## Ecommerce products

**File:** [SwarnaGrow_Ecommerce_Product_Intake.xlsx](./SwarnaGrow_Ecommerce_Product_Intake.xlsx)

Share this workbook with the jeweller so they can list shop products. They paste **Google Drive** image share links (Viewer access). Only product fields — no tax, banners, or payment setup.

Regenerate after column changes:

```bash
npm run template:ecommerce-products
```

Import into the database is a separate internal script (not included in the template).
